meta_title: SAM Construction | Garden Design & Landscaping Manchester
meta_description: SAM Construction brings your Manchester garden to life. Expert landscaping, garden design and maintenance. Free quotes. Call 07471 291964.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Landscaping & Garden Design — Levenshulme Based
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor spaces — we design and build gardens that work for your lifestyle.
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign or regular maintenance, we've got the skills and expertise to bring your vision to life.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your budget and space. We create detailed plans, source materials, and guide you through every step of the build.

services.title: Landscaping & Groundworks
services.desc: Patios, decking, raised beds, and retaining walls. We handle levelling, drainage, and construction to create a solid foundation for your garden.

services.title: Planting & Soft Landscaping
services.desc: Expert plant selection, borders, hedging, and turf laying. We choose plants suited to Manchester's climate and your maintenance preferences.

services.title: Fencing & Boundaries
services.desc: Strong, attractive fencing and gates that define your space and increase privacy. All materials sourced and installed to last.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Clearance
services.desc: Regular upkeep, seasonal tidying, and overgrown garden clearance. Keep your outdoor space looking immaculate year-round.

services.title: Water Features & Lighting
services.desc: Ponds, fountains, outdoor lighting, and electrics installed safely. Add atmosphere and usability to your garden after dark.

about_pullquote: I build gardens people actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: SAM Construction has been transforming Levenshulme and Manchester gardens for over a decade. We started because we saw a gap: too many garden firms promising the earth but delivering mediocre results. From the first site visit to the final plant, we manage every detail so you don't have to.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, deliver on time, and take genuine pride in our work. We're not cowboys: we're a trusted, local team that treats every garden like it's our own. Whether it's a weekend refresh or a total redesign, we bring experience, creativity, and practical know-how to every project.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About SAM Construction

reviews.text: We had an absolute tip of a garden when we moved in. Sam and the lads came in, cleared everything, built a new patio, and laid turf. Three weeks start to finish. Now it's our favourite room in the house. Really reasonable price too.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Couldn't recommend SAM Construction highly enough. They listened to what we wanted, showed us design options, and the workmanship was brilliant. The garden looks like something from a magazine. Professional and friendly throughout.
reviews.author: Emma K.

reviews.text: Got a quote off three firms. Sam was the only one who actually explained what he was doing and why. Didn't oversell us anything we didn't need. Finished ahead of schedule. They're proper tradesmen.
reviews.author: David R.
